features.feature: Numeric handle identity and null references
features.scope: Public lookup, semantic XRECORD/XData validation and mapped cloning agree on case-insensitive one-to-sixteen-digit hexadecimal identities. Zero references remain absent; arbitrary 320–329 values preserve lexical data and do not become clone dependencies.

Exact immutable subclass data with scoped display-block and public STYLE-name bindings, source normal/position, independent common metadata and guarded source-document lifecycle. Unresolved/private data remains stored; no whole-drawing rendering claim.

Recognized fixed row/column packets, independent type/flags/absence, scoped FIELD precedence and legacy text continuations. Unknown or ambiguous values do not become evaluated literals; optional backing scalar comparison declines incomplete schemas.

Separate object-ID, hard/soft pointer and hard/soft owner kinds; reciprocal owned-child graphs, null handles, exact external mappings and atomic registered-column replacement. Terminal erasure follows owned cells and rejects outside references.

Grouped and interleaved public arrays retain ordinal correspondence. Input counts include duplicates and null entries and must match exactly. Edits derive output counts from buffer contents; undocumented private leading counts remain wholly opaque.

features.feature: Mixed TABLE, DATATABLE and index lifecycle

Attach, mapped clone and terminal erase preserve reciprocal settings, complete typed owned metadata, source identity and independent values; unsupported opaque subtrees reject before allocation or callbacks.

features.scope: Coexisting stored graphs retain external reference identities, mapped cloneable subtrees, immutable-object rejection and source/destination erasure boundaries. Synthetic cross-family links and scoped native evidence are explicitly distinguished.

features.feature: Mixed DIMASSOC, UCS and TABLE backing graphs
features.scope: Shared dependencies retain exact identities across independent mutable consumers and immutable stored graphs. Mapped cloneable objects and rejected ancestor/profile operations are exercised together; scoped native packets and synthetic cross-family links are identified separately.

Qualified absent/zero suffixes, private framing boundaries and exact native zero-count bodies are tested in both transports. Override value grammar and editing remain open.

Original producer failures, empty unrelated DIMSTYLE pointers and corrupt binary hour payloads remain separately pinned; adapters change only listed unrelated null pointers. No typed SUNSTUDY editing or native CAD acceptance is qualified.

Source-bound update flag and ordered section pointers with exact registered identities, preserved object spelling, root-anchor checks and clone/erase/profile refusal. Native R2018 evidence is distinguished from synthetic R2007+ schema cases.
